chunks: Certainly, these people are in agreement in disliking my authority. I will carry on till I perceive disunity among you; because if, in spite of the unsoundness of their view, they succeed, the whole organization of the Muslims will be shattered. key_terms.رَدَّ الْأُمُورِ عَلَى أَدْبَارِهَا: Reverting matters to their backs (returning to the past/pre-Islamic state)
key_terms.فَيَالَة: Excess or abundance (here referring to the success or prevalence of their view)

ai.seo_question: What was Imam Ali's rationale for patience during the Battle of Jamal?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) characterizes the companions of the Battle of Jamal as driven by worldly envy rather than genuine religious conviction, warning that their persistence in this factional view would unravel the political and social fabric of the Muslim community. He frames his patience not as weakness, but as a strategic necessity to preserve the unity of the 'Jamāʿah' (the main body of Muslims) until the cost of conflict becomes too high. This stance underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on balancing adherence to the Quran and Sunnah with the pragmatic preservation of communal cohesion against internal dissent.
